summary: Terra-based lending and savings protocol best known for UST deposits marketed around high stablecoin yields before the May 2022 TerraUSD and LUNA collapse made the product economically nonfunctional.
what_happened: Anchor Protocol became the flagship yield venue for TerraUSD deposits. The SEC later described UST as being touted as a yield-bearing stablecoin paying as much as 20 percent interest through Anchor Protocol. When UST depegged in May 2022 and LUNA collapsed, Anchor's core UST yield product effectively ended as a usable savings product, though the protocol and community history remain relevant to the Terra collapse.
uncertainty_notes: Launch date and end date are operational approximations. The record tracks Anchor as a yield product within the Terra ecosystem, not as a conventional custodial CeFi bankruptcy case.
notes: Added because Anchor is one of the most important crypto yield-product failures and is directly referenced in SEC Terraform materials.
